core_obligations: Get part (1) from the pointwise criterion plus permanence of geometric reducedness under localization (proof lines 576-581).

Get part (2): let A be the local ring at x; the hypotheses make A reduced with geometrically reduced localizations at all minimal primes, so the algebra criterion makes A geometrically reduced, and the pointwise criterion then gives geometric reducedness of X at x (proof lines 584-590).
Get part (3) trivially from part (2), and part (4) from part (3) by the separable function field criterion (proof lines 593-595).
proof_roadmap: Part (2) through minimal primes of the local ring (proof lines 584-590).
difficulty_reason: The four-part lemma relates geometric reducedness at a point to geometric reducedness at generic points of irreducible components: it is inherited by specialisations, it can be checked at a point with reduced local ring once it holds at all generic points specialising to it, it holds globally for a reduced scheme that is geometrically reduced at all generic points, and for a variety it is equivalent to separability of the function field (statement lines 554-573). Part (1) is immediate from the pointwise criterion and the permanence of geometric reducedness under localization (proof lines 576-581). Part (2) is the substantive translation: the hypotheses say that the local ring at x is reduced and that its localizations at minimal primes are geometrically reduced, which by the algebra criterion makes the whole local ring geometrically reduced, and the pointwise criterion lifts that to X (proof lines 584-590). Part (3) then follows trivially and part (4) is the separable function field criterion (proof lines 593-595). The claim is H2: one localization observation, one local-to-global passage through minimal primes and one field-theoretic equivalence.
